lines:
flowchart TD
A["Recurring failure evidence is committed"] --> B["Fingerprint and group occurrence in persistent ledger"]
B --> C["Expose Management history diagnosis workaround and regression facts"]
C --> D{"User starts Investigate and fix?"}
D -- "No" --> E["Remain recorded. No autonomous repair loop"]
D -- "Yes" --> F["Bounded Management workflow investigates using frozen authority"]
F --> G["Register candidate with complete diff tests consequences uncertainty build provenance hashes data compatibility and rollback point"]
G --> H["Query BuildOriginV1 enrollment and runtime capability"]
H --> I{"ActivationEligibilityV1?"}
I -- "EnrollmentRequired" --> J["Keep current build. User may choose Enable local repair activation"]
J --> J1["Core commits RequestManagedLocalEnrollment with bounded local provenance and whole-bundle artifact"]
J1 --> J2["Bootstrap helper prepares and verifies managed root initial slot stable helper launcher journal and selector"]
J2 --> J3["Commit EnrollmentPreparedV1. User explicitly restarts through stable launcher"]
I -- "Unsupported packaged unknown conflicting or failed guarantee" --> K["Keep current build. Allow diagnosis build test export rebuild instructions and manual update"]
I -- "Supported ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1" --> L["Show local origin managed slots same-user integrity and complete candidate disclosure"]
L --> M{"User selects Activate and restart with candidate version and capability digest?"}
M -- "No or reject" --> N["Keep current build. Record rejection or defer candidate"]
M -- "Yes" --> O["Atomically commit activation decision capability digest ManagementCheckpointRefV1 previous build and RepairActivationBatonV1"]
O --> P["Hand authenticated baton to Trusted Bootstrap and Rollback Helper"]
P --> Q{"Independent provenance enrollment slot and capability revalidation still Supported?"}
Q -- "No" --> R["Helper durably returns BootstrapResultV1 Unsupported before quiescence. Current build remains active"]
R --> S["Core commits exact unavailable reason and keeps Management Chat available"]
Q -- "Yes" --> T["Core quiesces supervised children and exits. Helper proves complete current-generation cleanup"]
T --> U["Helper atomically selects candidate and launches fresh verification-only ProcessGenerationV1 under bounded watchdog"]
U --> V["Candidate performs generation and plan-bound focused verification without forward-only migration"]
V --> W{"Expected identity health and focused verification pass?"}
W -- "Yes" --> X["Helper seals BootstrapResultV1 ActivatedVerified with journal and integrity proofs"]
X --> Y["Candidate Core commits evidence and resumes the same Management Chat"]
W -- "No crash timeout mismatch unhealthy or failed check" --> Z["Helper terminates candidate tree restores and reverifies previous slot and relaunches rollback generation"]
Z --> ZA{"Previous generation launches safely?"}
ZA -- "Yes" --> AA["Helper seals BootstrapResultV1 RolledBack"]
AA --> AB["Previous Core commits rollback evidence and resumes the same Management task"]
ZA -- "No" --> MR["Helper seals ManualRecoveryRequired and ManualRecoveryNoticeV1"]
MR --> MR2["Stable launcher shows native diagnostic ID observed slot state fixed recovery instructions and exit only"]
MR2 --> MR3["A later successful Core imports the receipt into Management Chat"]
Y --> AC["Later recurrence is a regression never automatic re-repair"]
AB --> AC
MR3 --> AC
S --> AC

data.title: Managed-local repair eligibility, bounded activation, bootstrap restart, verification, and rollback
